description: Next buses from a bus stop anywhere in Great Britain. Takes a stop name with its town or area; many stops share a name across the country, so 'Trafalgar Square' alone can land in Greater Manchester while 'Trafalgar Square London' finds Charing Cross. A stop letter can follow, e.g. 'Trafalgar Square London stop X'. A stop's ATCO/NaPTAN code also works. Live predictions in London (TfL); elsewhere the timetable, so a 'scheduled' time is not a live estimate. With 'to', only buses that go on to that stop are listed, each with its scheduled time there: the answer to 'next bus from Trafalgar Square to Brixton Station'. Those boards always come from the timetable, with the live bus and its delay where it can be identified. Other matching stops are returned alongside.

stop.description: Stop name with town, optionally a stop letter, or a stop code: e.g. 'Trafalgar Square London stop X', '490015196OF'.

to.description: Optional stop the bus must go on to, with its town: e.g. 'Brixton Station London'. Every stop of that name there counts unless a stop letter is given.
